evidence.title: EMPIRE: Explicit Manipulation Planning as a Learnable Intermediate Representation for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting

summary: A new study presents EMPIRE, a learnable intermediate representation designed to improve explicit manipulation planning in AI models for predicting hand motions from a first-person perspective. The approach aims to enhance robotic and human-machine interaction applications.
title: Researchers Introduce EMPIRE: A New AI Framework for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting
